dayHealth.sql:
SELECT po.obs_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS n,
       COUNT(DISTINCT po.country_code) AS n_countries,
       COUNT(DISTINCT po.channel_id) AS n_channels
FROM price_obs po
WHERE po.product_kind = 'device' AND po.is_bundle = 0 AND po.condition = 'new' AND po.audit_status <> 'rejected'
  AND po.obs_date BETWEEN :winStart AND :winEnd
GROUP BY po.obs_date ORDER BY po.obs_date

coverage.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT po.id, po.obs_date, po.country_code, po.channel_id, po.brand_id,
         po.category_code, po.title, po.model_guess, po.rom_gb, po.ram_gb,
         po.sale_price, po.list_price, po.currency, po.discount_pct,
         po.installments, po.is_bundle, po.seller_kind, po.sku_code,
         b.name AS brand_name, ch.name AS channel_name
  FROM price_obs po
  JOIN brand b ON b.id = po.brand_id
  LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = po.channel_id
  WHERE po.product_kind = 'device' AND po.is_bundle = 0 AND po.condition = 'new' AND po.audit_status <> 'rejected'
    AND b.is_ours = 0
    AND (po.sale_price > CASE po.country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN 1500 WHEN 'CL' THEN 50000 WHEN 'CO' THEN 250000 WHEN 'PE' THEN 250 WHEN 'BR' THEN 400 WHEN 'AR' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END)
    AND (LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%funda%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%forro%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%estuche%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%case%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%carcasa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%mica%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%vidrio%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%lamina%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%hidrogel%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%protector%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%cargador%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%flex%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%repuesto%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%pelicula%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%película%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%capa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%capinha%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%correa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%pulseira%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%soporte%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%adaptador%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%cable%')
    AND po.obs_date BETWEEN :winStart AND :winEnd
)
SELECT country_code AS country, category_code AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_n,
       COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(model_guess, ''), title)) AS models,
       COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) AS channels,
       COUNT(DISTINCT obs_date) AS days,
       COUNT(DISTINCT brand_id) AS brands
FROM filtered
GROUP BY country_code, category_code

promoBoard.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT po.id, po.obs_date, po.country_code, po.channel_id, po.brand_id,
         po.category_code, po.title, po.model_guess, po.rom_gb, po.ram_gb,
         po.sale_price, po.list_price, po.currency, po.discount_pct,
         po.installments, po.is_bundle, po.seller_kind, po.sku_code,
         b.name AS brand_name, ch.name AS channel_name
  FROM price_obs po
  JOIN brand b ON b.id = po.brand_id
  LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = po.channel_id
  WHERE po.product_kind = 'device' AND po.is_bundle = 0 AND po.condition = 'new' AND po.audit_status <> 'rejected'
    AND b.is_ours = 0
    AND (po.sale_price > CASE po.country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN 1500 WHEN 'CL' THEN 50000 WHEN 'CO' THEN 250000 WHEN 'PE' THEN 250 WHEN 'BR' THEN 400 WHEN 'AR' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END)
    AND (LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%funda%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%forro%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%estuche%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%case%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%carcasa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%mica%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%vidrio%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%lamina%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%hidrogel%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%protector%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%cargador%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%flex%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%repuesto%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%pelicula%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%película%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%capa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%capinha%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%correa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%pulseira%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%soporte%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%adaptador%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%cable%')
    AND po.obs_date BETWEEN :winStart AND :winEnd
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT brand_name || '|' || country_code || '|' || category_code AS k, discount_pct AS v,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand_name || '|' || country_code || '|' || category_code ORDER BY discount_pct) AS rn,
         COUNT(*)     OVER (PARTITION BY brand_name || '|' || country_code || '|' || category_code) AS c
  FROM filtered
  WHERE discount_pct > 0
)
,
med AS (
  SELECT k,
  MAX(c) AS n,
  AVG(CASE WHEN rn * 2 IN (c + 1, c + 2) THEN v END) AS med,
  AVG(CASE WHEN rn = (c + 3) / 4 THEN v END)         AS p25,
  AVG(CASE WHEN rn = (3 * c + 3) / 4 THEN v END)     AS p75,
  MIN(v) AS mn, MAX(v) AS mx
  FROM ranked GROUP BY k
),
tot AS (
  SELECT brand_name || '|' || country_code || '|' || category_code AS k,
         COUNT(*) AS n_all,
         SUM(CASE WHEN discount_pct > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_promo,
         COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) AS n_channels,
         COUNT(DISTINCT obs_date) AS n_days
  FROM filtered GROUP BY k
)
SELECT t.k AS group_key, t.n_all, t.n_promo, t.n_channels, t.n_days,
       CAST(t.n_promo AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.n_all, 0) AS breadth,
       m.med AS depth, m.p25, m.p75, m.mn, m.mx, m.n AS depth_n
FROM tot t LEFT JOIN med m ON m.k = t.k
WHERE t.n_all >= :minRows
ORDER BY t.n_all DESC

priceByStorage.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT po.id, po.obs_date, po.country_code, po.channel_id, po.brand_id,
         po.category_code, po.title, po.model_guess, po.rom_gb, po.ram_gb,
         po.sale_price, po.list_price, po.currency, po.discount_pct,
         po.installments, po.is_bundle, po.seller_kind, po.sku_code,
         b.name AS brand_name, ch.name AS channel_name
  FROM price_obs po
  JOIN brand b ON b.id = po.brand_id
  LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = po.channel_id
  WHERE po.product_kind = 'device' AND po.is_bundle = 0 AND po.condition = 'new' AND po.audit_status <> 'rejected'
    AND b.is_ours = 0
    AND (po.sale_price > CASE po.country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN 1500 WHEN 'CL' THEN 50000 WHEN 'CO' THEN 250000 WHEN 'PE' THEN 250 WHEN 'BR' THEN 400 WHEN 'AR' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END)
    AND (LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%funda%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%forro%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%estuche%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%case%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%carcasa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%mica%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%vidrio%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%lamina%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%hidrogel%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%protector%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%cargador%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%flex%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%repuesto%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%pelicula%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%película%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%capa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%capinha%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%correa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%pulseira%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%soporte%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%adaptador%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%cable%')
    AND po.obs_date BETWEEN :winStart AND :winEnd
),
hit AS (
  SELECT * FROM filtered
  WHERE model_guess IS NOT NULL AND model_guess <> ''
    AND model_guess NOT IN ('白牌-未识别', '未识别', 'Others', 'unknown')
    AND LOWER(model_guess) LIKE LOWER(:modelLike)
    AND sale_price > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(rom_gb, -1) || '|' || country_code || '|' || currency AS k, sale_price AS v,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(rom_gb, -1) || '|' || country_code || '|' || currency ORDER BY sale_price) AS rn,
         COUNT(*)     OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(rom_gb, -1) || '|' || country_code || '|' || currency) AS c
  FROM hit
)

SELECT k AS group_key,
  MAX(c) AS n,
  AVG(CASE WHEN rn * 2 IN (c + 1, c + 2) THEN v END) AS med,
  AVG(CASE WHEN rn = (c + 3) / 4 THEN v END)         AS p25,
  AVG(CASE WHEN rn = (3 * c + 3) / 4 THEN v END)     AS p75,
  MIN(v) AS mn, MAX(v) AS mx
FROM ranked GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

launchCards.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT po.brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, po.rival_product_id,
         po.model_guess AS model_key,
         po.country_code, po.category_code, po.obs_date, po.sale_price, po.currency
  FROM price_obs po JOIN brand b ON b.id = po.brand_id
  WHERE po.product_kind = 'device' AND po.is_bundle = 0 AND po.condition = 'new' AND po.audit_status <> 'rejected'
    AND b.is_ours = 0
    AND (po.sale_price > CASE po.country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN 1500 WHEN 'CL' THEN 50000 WHEN 'CO' THEN 250000 WHEN 'PE' THEN 250 WHEN 'BR' THEN 400 WHEN 'AR' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END)
    AND (LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%funda%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%forro%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%estuche%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%case%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%carcasa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%mica%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%vidrio%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%lamina%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%hidrogel%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%protector%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%cargador%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%flex%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%repuesto%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%pelicula%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%película%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%capa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%capinha%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%correa%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%pulseira%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%soporte%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%adaptador%' AND LOWER(po.title) NOT LIKE '%cable%')
    AND (po.model_guess IS NOT NULL AND po.model_guess <> ''
     AND po.model_guess NOT IN ('白牌-未识别', '未识别', 'Others', 'unknown'))
    AND po.obs_date >= :scanSince
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT brand_name, model_key, country_code, category_code,
         MIN(obs_date) AS first_seen, COUNT(*) AS n,
         COUNT(DISTINCT obs_date) AS n_days,
         MAX(rival_product_id) AS rp_id
  FROM base GROUP BY brand_name, model_key, country_code, category_code
),
regionFirst AS (
  SELECT brand_name, model_key, category_code,
         MIN(obs_date) AS region_first_seen,
         COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) AS n_countries
  FROM base GROUP BY brand_name, model_key, category_code
)
SELECT f.brand_name, f.model_key, f.country_code, f.category_code,
       f.first_seen, f.n, f.n_days,
       rf.region_first_seen, rf.n_countries,
       COALESCE(rp1.chipset, rp2.chipset)         AS chipset,
       COALESCE(rp1.battery_mah, rp2.battery_mah) AS battery_mah,
       COALESCE(rp1.screen_size, rp2.screen_size) AS screen_size,
       COALESCE(rp1.series, rp2.series)           AS series,
       COALESCE(rp1.extra_specs, rp2.extra_specs) AS extra_specs,
       COALESCE(rp1.spec_source, rp2.spec_source) AS spec_source
FROM firsts f
JOIN regionFirst rf ON rf.brand_name = f.brand_name
                   AND rf.model_key = f.model_key
                   AND rf.category_code = f.category_code
LEFT JOIN rival_product rp1 ON rp1.id = f.rp_id
LEFT JOIN rival_product rp2
  ON rp2.category_code = f.category_code
 AND rp2.model_key = LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(f.model_key, ' ', ''), '-', ''))
WHERE f.first_seen >= :newSince AND f.first_seen <= :newUntil
ORDER BY f.first_seen DESC, f.n DESC
LIMIT :limit

priceMoves.sql:
SELECT pm.move_date, pm.country_code, pm.category_code,
       b.name AS brand, ch.name AS channel,
       pm.prev_price, pm.curr_price, pm.change_pct, pm.direction,
       pm.prev_date, pm.days_span, pm.currency, pm.sku_key, pm.is_official
FROM price_move pm
JOIN brand b ON b.id = pm.brand_id
LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = pm.channel_id
WHERE pm.move_date BETWEEN :winStart AND :winEnd
  AND ABS(pm.change_pct) >= :minPct
  AND b.is_ours = 0
ORDER BY ABS(pm.change_pct) DESC
LIMIT :limit

    AND po.obs_date BETWEEN :winStart AND :winEnd
)
SELECT brand_name, category_code, model_guess AS model_key,
       COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) AS n_countries,
       MIN(obs_date) AS first_seen, MAX(obs_date) AS last_seen
FROM filtered
WHERE model_guess IS NOT NULL AND model_guess <> ''
  AND model_guess NOT IN ('白牌-未识别', '未识别', 'Others', 'unknown')
  AND (:brand IS NULL OR brand_name = :brand)
  AND (:category IS NULL OR category_code = :category)
GROUP BY brand_name, category_code, model_guess
HAVING n >= :minRows
ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT :limit
